entities.name: Query RlmN methyltransferase
observations: A 360-residue sequence contains Pfam RlmN_N (positions 5–63) and Radical_SAM (positions 115–277) domains.
Near-full-length Swiss-Prot homologs show 40.7–42.6% identity, approximately 98% coverage, and are annotated as probable dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase RlmN.
The enzyme is inferred to bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and to use S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM).

entities.name: RlmN RNA adenine C2 methylation
observations: EC 2.1.1.192 reaction: methylation of adenosine at position 2503 in 23S rRNA or position 37 in tRNA to form 2-methyladenosine, using SAM and a radical-SAM [4Fe-4S] cluster system.
The reaction produces 5'-deoxyadenosine and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the annotated overall stoichiometry; exact electron-transfer bookkeeping may depend on reaction representation.

entities.name: RlmN [4Fe-4S] cofactor
observations: RlmN-family homologs are annotated to bind one [4Fe-4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines, with SAM as the exchangeable substrate/cofactor component.
